description: Source code for the PoDatabaseReader class, which implements a Gettext PO reader for the Drupal locale module, handling database interactions for translation strings.

classes.name: PoDatabaseReader
classes.description: Implements a Gettext PO reader that interacts with Drupal's locale module database to retrieve translation strings based on specified options.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the language code of the language being read.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the reader.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the current options used by the reader.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets the options for the reader, with default values for customization and translation filters.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns a new PoHeader object initialized with the current language code.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Throws an exception; setting header is not supported in this reader.

methods.name: loadStrings
methods.description: Builds and executes a database query to load translation strings based on current options.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Retrieves the next string from the loaded results.

methods.name: readItem
methods.description: Reads a translation item and returns it as a PoItem object.
